name: @teasel/parser
description: A JavaScript and TypeScript parser in Rust. It answers in ESTree.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release -p teasel-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && node scripts/wasm.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:js && node scripts/test.ts && node --no-addons scripts/test.ts && node scripts/test.ts web interpret && node --input-type=commonjs -e "require('@teasel/parser').parse('x')" && node --no-addons --input-type=commonjs -e "require('@teasel/parser').parse('x')"
